# `/non-employee-requests` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /non-employee-requests/v1

`createNonEmployeeRequestV1` — Create non-employee request

This request will create a non-employee request and notify the approver. Requires role context of `idn:nesr:create` or the user must own the source.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Body (application/json): nonemployeerequestbody
- Returns 200: nonemployeerequest

### GET /non-employee-requests/v1

`listNonEmployeeRequestsV1` — List non-employee requests

This gets a list of non-employee requests. There are two contextual uses for the `requested-for` path parameter: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:read`, in which case he or she may request a list non-employee requests assigned to a particular account manager by passing in that manager's id. 2. The current user is an account manager, in which case "me" should be provided as the `requested-for` value. This will provide the user with a list of the non-employee requests in the…

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `requested-for` (query, required) — The identity for whom the request was made. *me* indicates the current user.
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: created, approvalStatus, firstName, lastName, email, phone, accountName, startDate, endDate — e.g. `created,approvalStatus`
  - `filters` (query) — fields: sourceId: eq — e.g. `sourceId eq "2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"`
- Returns 200: array of nonemployeerequest

### GET /non-employee-requests/v1/{id}

`getNonEmployeeRequestV1` — Get a non-employee request

This gets a non-employee request. There are two contextual uses for this endpoint: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:read`, in this case the user can get the non-employee request for any user. 2. The user must be the owner of the non-employee request.

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-Employee request id (UUID)
- Returns 200: nonemployeerequest

### DELETE /non-employee-requests/v1/{id}

`deleteNonEmployeeRequestV1` — Delete non-employee request

This request will delete a non-employee request. Requires role context of `idn:nesr:delete`

- Scopes: idn:nelm:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Non-Employee request id in the UUID format
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /non-employee-requests/v1/summary/{requested-for}

`getNonEmployeeRequestSummaryV1` — Get summary of non-employee requests

This request will retrieve a summary of non-employee requests. There are two contextual uses for the `requested-for` path parameter: 1. The user has the role context of `idn:nesr:read`, in which case he or she may request a summary of all non-employee approval requests assigned to a particular account manager by passing in that manager's id. 2. The current user is an account manager, in which case "me" should be provided as the `requested-for` value. This will provide the user with a summary…

- Scopes: idn:nelm:read
- Parameters:
  - `requested-for` (path, required) — The identity (UUID) of the non-employee account manager for whom the summary is being retrieved. Use "me" instead to indicate the current user.
- Returns 200: nonemployeerequestsummary
